chapter.verse: Ni khat, Jesu in biakinnpi sunga om mite' kiangah thu hilhcianin Lungdamna Thu tangko-in a om laitak, makaite tawh kithuahin siampi liante leh laisiamte hong pai uh a,
Jesu' kiangah, "Hong gen dih in: Bang thuneihna tawh hih nate sem na hi hiam? Ahihkeileh zong hih thuneihna kua'n hong pia hiam?" ci-in dong uh hi.
Jesu in, "Kei zong thu khat kong dong ding hi. Hong gen dih un:
John' baptizena vantung pan hiam, mite' kiangpan hiam?" ci-in dong hi.
Tua ciangin tua mite khatlekhat kikum uh a, "Eite in, 'Vantung pan hi,' ci lehang, amah'n, 'Tua ahihleh bang hangin amah um lo na hi uh hiam?' hong ci ding hi.
Ahih hangin, 'Mite' kiangpan hi,' ci lehang lah mi khempeuh in John pen kamsang khatin sang uh ahih manin ei teng suang tawh hong denglum ding uh hi," kici uh hi.
Tua hangin koi pan hong pai cih ka thei kei uh, ci-in dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, "Ke'n zong hihte bang thuneihna tawh ka sep kong gen kei ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in mite' tungah hih thugenteh gen hi: "Mi khat in lenggah lo khat nei a, lokhawhlawhte semsakin gamdang khat ah sawtveipi taam dingin pai hi.

A hun a tun ciangin lo pana piang lenggah kimkhat a piak theih nadingun loneipu in lokhawhlawhte' kiangah a silate khat sawl hi. Ahih hangin lokhawhlawhte in tua silapa na vua uh a, khutguakin ciahsak uh hi.
Tua ciangin loneipu in sila dang khat sawl leuleu hi. Ahi zongin tua mite in na vua leuleu uh a, a simmawhbawl khit uh ciangin khutguakin ciahsak uh hi.
Loneipu in sila a thumna sawl leuleu hi. Tua zong amaute in liamsakin hawlkhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin loneipu in, 'Bang ka cih ding hiam? Ka tapa it ka sawl ding hi. Tua mite in na thupisim sam ding uh hi,' ci hi.
Ahih hangin tua mite in amah a muh ciangin khatlekhat kiho uh a, 'Hih pa gamhluahpa hi. Ama' gamhluah ding teng eimau' a a suah theih nadingin amah that ni,' ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua mite in lenggah lo pualam ah lawnkhia-in thatlum uh hi. Tua bang ahih manin loneipu in lokhawhlawhte bang a cih ding hiam?
Amah hong pai-in tua lokhawhlawhte susiain lenggah lo pen midangte pia ding hi." Mite in hih thu a zak uh ciangin, "Hikei ta hen!" ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in amaute tangtak enin hih bangin ci hi: "Tua ahihleh hih a kigelh thu bang ahi hiam? "'Innlamte' nilkhiat suangtum, khuambul suangpi suak khinta hi.'"
"Tua suang tunga a tuk mi khempeuh kitatzan mang ding a, mi khatpeuh tungah tua suang a tuk leh zong dengzan gawp ding hi."
Laisiamte leh siampi liante in hih Jesu' thugenteh pen amau a kawkna-in a gen ahihlam thei uh ahih manin tua hunlenai mahin Jesu mat theih nading thu zong uh a, ahi zongin mihonpi kihta zel uh hi.
Tua hangin amaute in gam-uk mangpa' ukna thu leh thukhenna sungah a ap theih nadingun Jesu a kampau tawh mawhmat nuamin encik uh a, midik a kineih simtham thukante khah uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Jesu' kiangah, "Sya aw, nang pen thu ahi bangin genin a hilh, maitang ettuam a neilo, thumaan thutak siksanin Pasian' lampi a hilh na hihlam kong thei uh hi.
Kumpi Caesar' tungah siah i piak ding phaltheih ahi hiam, hilo hiam?" ci-in dong uh hi.
Jesu in ahihleh a zuau khuak uh na thei ahih manin,
"Denarius tang khat hong lak dih un. Kua' limlemel leh kua' min tuang ahi hiam?" a cih ciangin tua mite in, "Caesar' limlemel leh min," ci uh hi.
Jesu in, "Tua ahihleh Caesar' a ahite Caesar pia unla Pasian' a ahite Pasian pia un," ci hi.
Tua bangin amaute in mite' mai-ah Jesu a kampau tawh mawhmat zolo uh a, Jesu' dawnna lamdang sa mahmah uh ahih manin pau lo-in daicip uh hi.
(Thawhkikna om lo ci-a a nial) Sadduceetec Jesu' kiangah hong pai uh hi.
Thu khat dong uh a, "Sya aw, Moses in eite' ading hong gelhsakna ah pasal khat ta nei lo-in a zi a sihsan leh ama' sanggampa in tua meigongnu tenpihin a sipa' suanlekhak neihsak ding hi, ci hi.
Tu-in unau pasal sagih om ngei hi. A upen in zi khat la a, ta nei lo-in si hi.
Tua ciangin a nihnae
leh a thumna in meigongnu la a, tua dan mahin sagihte a vekun ta nei lo-in si uh hi.
Tua nungah numeinu zong si hi.
Tua ahih manin thawhkikna hun ah tua numei pen a koipen ii zi ahi ding hiam? A hang pen a sagihun tua numei tenpih tek uh hi," ci uh hi.
Jesu in amaute' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: "Tulai khangmite kitengin mopi mokha uh hi.
Ahih hangin tua khanghun a ngah dinga kilawmte leh misite' lakpan a thokik dinga kilawmte ahihleh kiteng lo ding uh a, mopi mokha cih zong om lo ding uh hi.
A hang pen thawhkikna tate ahih manun amau pen vanmite tawh kikim ta uh a, Pasian' tate hita uh ahih manin si thei nawnlo ding uh hi.
Misite kithokiksak cih thu, Moses nangawn in sawlbawk gei-ah Abraham' Pasian, Isaac' Pasian, Jacob' Pasian ci-in Topa a sap lai-in hong lak khin hi.
Tua hi a, mi khempeuh Pasian' ading nungta ahih manin Pasian pen misite' Pasian hilo-in a nungtate' Pasian ahi hi."
Tua ciangin laisiamte kimkhat in, "Sya aw, na thugen hoih mahmah hi," ci-in dawng uh hi.
A hang pen amaute in Jesu' kiangah thu bangmah dong ngam nawnlo uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in tua mite' kiangah hih bangin ci hi: "Bang hangin amaute in Khris pen David' Tapa ci thei uh ahi hiam?
David mahmah in Phatna Late sungah hih bangin ci hi: 'Topa in ka Topa' kiangah ci hi, "Ka taklam ah tu in aw,
na galte na khe-ngakna tokhom ka suahsak mateng maw." '
"Tua hi a, Khris pen David in Topa ci ahih manin a tapa hithei ding ahi hiam?"
Tua ciangin Jesu in mi khempeuh' zakin a nungzuite' tungah hih bangin ci hi:

"Laisiamte tawh kisai kidawm un. Tua mite puantualpi tawh vak nuamin sumbuktualte ah mi' hopih ding ut uh a, vengkhawm innte ah tutphah hoihpen leh pawi bawlnate ah mithupite' tutna mun ngah nuam uh hi.
Meigongte' innlelo nektumsak uh a, a kiseel nadingun a thungette uh sausak uh hi. Tua mite in mawhsak thukhenna a sukzaw ngah ding uh hi."Meigongnu' Khiat Sumpi
